name: Diverse Music Library
description: Users want a more extensive music library with less repetitive recommendations to discover new songs and artists. This need is evident from complaints about the limited song library and repetitive playlists.

name: Personalized Recommendations
description: Users desire a more personalized song recommendation system that adapts to their taste, reducing repetitive listening behavior. This is clear from feedback about the algorithm's inability to suggest relevant music.
example_phrase: recommend song according to your taste

name: Intuitive Discovery UI
description: Users need a simplified and intuitive user interface for music discovery, making it easier to explore and find new music. This is reflected in criticisms of the app's confusing design and cluttered sections.

name: Social Music Sharing
description: Users want an in-app social layer for music sharing and discovery, allowing them to share and discover music with friends. This is evident from suggestions for improving social features and music sharing.

name: Transparent Recommendation Logic
description: Users desire transparency in the recommendation logic, understanding why certain songs are suggested to them. This need is reflected in comments about the algorithm's lack of clarity and repetitive suggestions.
